interval_telescope.statement:
theorem interval_telescope (s : ℕ → G) (i n : ℕ) :
    segment s i n = (prefixWord s i)⁻¹ * prefixWord s (i + n)

recover_generators.statement:
theorem recover_generators (s : ℕ → G) (i : ℕ) :
    (prefixWord s i)⁻¹ * prefixWord s (i + 1) = s i

recover_coordinates.statement:
theorem recover_coordinates (a : ℕ → G) (ha : a 0 = 1) (i : ℕ) :
    prefixWord (fun j => (a j)⁻¹ * a (j + 1)) i = a i

subgroup_dictionary.statement:
theorem subgroup_dictionary (s : ℕ → G) (J : Set ℕ) :
    intervalSubgroup s J = differenceSubgroup (prefixWord s) J

intersection_transport.statement:
theorem intersection_transport (s : ℕ → G) :
    (∀ I J, intervalSubgroup s I ⊓ intervalSubgroup s J = intervalSubgroup s (I ∩ J)) ↔
    (∀ I J, differenceSubgroup (prefixWord s) I ⊓ differenceSubgroup (prefixWord s) J =
      differenceSubgroup (prefixWord s) (I ∩ J))

reflected_second.statement:
theorem reflected_second (a b : G) (f : G ≃* G)
    (ha : f a = a⁻¹) (hb : f b = b) :
    f (a⁻¹ * b) = a ^ 2 * (a⁻¹ * b)

inversion_automorphism_square.statement:
theorem inversion_automorphism_square (S : Set G)
    (hS : Subgroup.closure S = ⊤) (f : G ≃* G)
    (hf : ∀ x ∈ S, f x = x⁻¹) :
    ∀ x : G, f (f x) = x

interpretation.interval_telescope: Actual recursively defined arbitrary interval equals the two prefix-coordinate difference; no commutativity assumption.
interpretation.recover_generators: Adjacent prefix difference recovers each original generator.
interpretation.recover_coordinates: Normalized a0=1 is explicitly assumed; successive differences reconstruct the arbitrary coordinate sequence.
interpretation.subgroup_dictionary: Actual Subgroup.closure objects, with inverse-membership for reversed pairs; including n=0 adds only identity.
interpretation.intersection_transport: Universal subgroup-intersection equality transfers through actual concrete closure equality. This is not a geometric recognition theorem.
interpretation.reflected_second: Automorphism f assumes f(a)=a^-1 and f(b)=b; b²=1 is supplied by the written application, not silently assumed by Lean.
interpretation.inversion_automorphism_square: Closure of the inverted set is top; induction proves f² fixes every element.
